services.name: Cabins
services.desc: Have no luck in getting booked to our RV glamping unit? Not a fan of packing and setting up a bulky tent? Our cozy cabins are the perfect alternative! Just bring your sleeping bag and enjoy a hassle-free camping experience in one of our charming cabins. Plus, we’re the ideal starting or ending point for your ferry trip from or back to Vancouver-just a 20-minute drive from both Departure Bay and Duke Point terminals! - There is a light, a baseboard heater , a fan, and a plug for charging your essentials, eg. phones. - No water, no sewer in cabins. Public washroom is about 3 minutes walking
